title: Mobile Money
details: Network, number and registered account name will be published here once NCRI-Ghana has verified its official payment accounts.

title: Bank transfer (GHS)
details: Bank, branch and account details will be published here once verified.

title: Give through a local partner
details: Local partner organisations that collect gifts on behalf of NCRI-Ghana will be listed here. If your organisation would like to take part, get in touch.

title: In-kind gifts and skills
details: Books, school supplies, seed, tools or professional skills can be offered through our team. Tell us what you would like to give and we will confirm what is needed.

title: International bank transfer
details: Bank name, SWIFT/BIC, IBAN or account number and reference instructions will be published here once verified.

title: Foundations, institutions and companies
details: We welcome grants, corporate giving and multi-year partnerships. Send a partnership enquiry and we will share a programme brief.

title: Card and mobile money checkout
details: Secure online checkout is provided by a licensed payment partner. It becomes available once the administrator has connected a payment account.
